inputs.text: Open your eyes to the coordinated manipulation happening right in front of us. The owner of Blue Waters comes out with a controlled narrative, claiming that the Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything.” This is entirely staged by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the curtain to manage public perception. Do not buy their official cover story. When they try to spin it by saying, "Perhaps this might be considered as an environmental tax," that is the glaring red flag exposing their true agenda of deeper extraction and control over commerce. They deliberately manufacture the crisis, pushing the scripted line that "Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter..." to condition the public into accepting centralized oversight. The mess in the rivers is managed chaos, proving that everything we are told is a complete inversion of reality orchestrated by the architects of the system.
